```csharp
private static int CountFragment(byte[] seq, int seqLen, byte[] frag)
{
    int L = frag.Length;
    if (L == 0 || seqLen < L) return 0;
    ulong fh = 0;

    ulong wh = 0;

                {
                    if (seq[pos + k] != frag[k]) { ok = false; break; }
                }
                if (ok) count++;
            }
        }
    }
    return count;
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Globalization;
using System.IO;
using System.Text;

public static class Program
{
    private static readonly string[] FragmentNames =
    {
        "GGT",
        "GGTA",
        "GGTATT",
        "GGTATTTTAATT",
        "GGTATTTTAATTTATAGT"
    };

    private static readonly byte[][] FragmentBytes = BuildFragmentBytes();

    private static readonly byte[] CodeTable = BuildCodeTable();

    private static byte[] BuildCodeTable()
    {
        byte[] table = new byte[256];
        for (int c = 0; c < 256; c++) table[c] = (byte)(c & 3);
        table['A'] = 0;
        table['C'] = 1;
        table['G'] = 2;
        table['T'] = 3;
        return table;
    }

    private static byte[][] BuildFragmentBytes()
    {
        byte[][] result = new byte[FragmentNames.Length][];
        for (int i = 0; i < FragmentNames.Length; i++)
        {
            string s = FragmentNames[i];
            byte[] b = new byte[s.Length];
            for (int j = 0; j < s.Length; j++) b[j] = (byte)s[j];
            result[i] = b;
        }
        return result;
    }

    public static void Main(string[] args)
    {
        // Harness contract: N is provided as args[0]. This benchmark is driven entirely
        // by stdin, so N is parsed (per contract) but does not affect the computation.
        if (args != null && args.Length > 0)
        {
            int parsedN;
            int.TryParse(args[0], out parsedN);
        }

        byte[] data = ReadAllStdin();
        int seqLen = ExtractThreeSequence(data);

        // Count 1-mers and 2-mers in a single pass.
        int[] counts1 = new int[256];
        int[] counts2 = new int[65536];
        int[] codeTable = CodeTable;
        int prev = -1;
        for (int j = 0; j < seqLen; j++)
        {
            int c = data[j];
            counts1[c]++;
            if (prev >= 0) counts2[(prev << 8) | c]++;
            prev = c;
        }

        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder(1024);
        AppendFrequencies(sb, counts1, 256, seqLen, 1);
        sb.Append('\n');
        AppendFrequencies(sb, counts2, 65536, seqLen - 1, 2);
        sb.Append('\n');

        for (int f = 0; f < FragmentNames.Length; f++)
        {
            int count = CountFragment(data, seqLen, FragmentBytes[f]);
            sb.Append(count).Append('\t').Append(FragmentNames[f]).Append('\n');
        }

        Console.Out.Write(sb.ToString());
    }

    private static void AppendFrequencies(StringBuilder sb, int[] counts, int space, int total, int k)
    {
        if (total <= 0) return;
        List<int> indices = new List<int>();
        for (int i = 0; i < space; i++)
        {
            if (counts[i] > 0) indices.Add(i);
        }
        indices.Sort(delegate(int a, int b)
        {
            int byCount = counts[b].CompareTo(counts[a]);
            if (byCount != 0) return byCount;
            return a.CompareTo(b);
        });
        double denom = total;
        for (int e = 0; e < indices.Count; e++)
        {
            int i = indices[e];
            double pct = 100.0 * counts[i] / denom;
            sb.Append(pct.ToString("F3", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
            sb.Append(' ');
            if (k == 1)
            {
                sb.Append((char)i);
            }
            else
            {
                sb.Append((char)(i >> 8));
                sb.Append((char)(i & 255));
            }
            sb.Append('\n');
        }
    }

    private static int CountFragment(byte[] seq, int seqLen, byte[] frag)
    {
        int L = frag.Length;
        if (L == 0 || seqLen < L) return 0;
        byte[] codeTable = CodeTable;
        ulong fh = 0;
        for (int j = 0; j < L; j++) fh = (fh << 2) | codeTable[frag[j]];
        ulong mask = (2 * L) < 64 ? ((1UL << (2 * L)) - 1) : ~0UL;
        ulong wh = 0;
        int last = L - 1;
        for (int j = 0; j < last; j++) wh = (wh << 2) | codeTable[seq[j]];
        int count = 0;
        for (int j = last; j < seqLen; j++)
        {
            wh = (wh << 2) | codeTable[seq[j]];
            if ((wh & mask) == fh)
            {
                int pos = j - last;
                bool ok = true;
                for (int t = 0; t < L; t++)
                {
                    if (seq[pos + t] != frag[t]) { ok = false; break; }
                }
                if (ok) count++;
            }
        }
        return count;
    }

    private static byte[] ReadAllStdin()
    {
        using (Stream stdin = Console.OpenStandardInput())
        {
            MemoryStream ms = new MemoryStream();
            byte[] buffer = new byte[1 << 16];
            int n;
            while ((n = stdin.Read(buffer, 0, buffer.Length)) > 0)
            {
                ms.Write(buffer, 0, n);
            }
            return ms.ToArray();
        }
    }

    private static int ExtractThreeSequence(byte[] data)
    {
        int header = FindThreeHeader(data);
        int start;
        int end;
        if (header >= 0)
        {
            int i = header;
            while (i < data.Length && data[i] != (byte)'\n') i++;
            start = (i < data.Length) ? i + 1 : data.Length;
            end = IndexOfByte(data, (byte)'>', start);
            if (end < 0) end = data.Length;
        }
        else
        {
            start = 0;
            end = data.Length;
        }

        int write = 0;
        int read = start;
        while (read < end)
        {
            byte b = data[read];
            if (b == 10 || b == 13 || b == 32 || b == 9)
            {
                read++;
                continue;
            }
            if (b == (byte)'>')
            {
                while (read < end && data[read] != (byte)'\n') read++;
                continue;
            }
            if (b >= 97 && b <= 122) b = (byte)(b - 32);
            data[write++] = b;
            read++;
        }
        return write;
    }

    private static int FindThreeHeader(byte[] data)
    {
        int pos = 0;
        while (true)
        {
            int gt = IndexOfByte(data, (byte)'>', pos);
            if (gt < 0) return -1;
            if (gt + 6 <= data.Length
                && data[gt + 1] == (byte)'T'
                && data[gt + 2] == (byte)'H'
                && data[gt + 3] == (byte)'R'
                && data[gt + 4] == (byte)'E'
                && data[gt + 5] == (byte)'E')
            {
                return gt;
            }
            pos = gt + 1;
        }
    }

    private static int IndexOfByte(byte[] data, byte value, int start)
    {
        for (int i = start; i < data.Length; i++)
        {
            if (data[i] == value) return i;
        }
        return -1;
    }
}
```

```csharp
        outBuffer.Append('\n');

    private static void AppendFrequencies(StringBuilder sb, int[] counts, int space, int total, int k)
    {
        if (total <= 0)
        {
            return;
        }

        List<int> indices = new List<int>();
        for (int i = 0; i < space; i++)
        {
            if (counts[i] > 0)
            {
                indices.Add(i);
            }
        }

        indices.Sort(delegate(int a, int b)
        {
            int byCount = counts[b].CompareTo(counts[a]);
            if (byCount != 0)
            {
                return byCount;
            }
            return a.CompareTo(b);
        });

        double denominator = total;
        for (int e = 0; e < indices.Count; e++)
        {
            int i = indices[e];
            double pct = 100.0 * counts[i] / denominator;
            sb.Append(pct.ToString("F3", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
            sb.Append(' ');
            if (k == 1)
            {
                sb.Append((char)i);
            }
            else
            {
                sb.Append((char)(i >> 8));
                sb.Append((char)(i & 255));
            }
            sb.Append('\n');
        }

    private static int CountFragment(byte[] seq, int seqLen, byte[] frag)

        int len = frag.Length;
        if (len == 0 || seqLen < len)
        {
            return 0;
        }

        byte[] codeTable = CodeTable;
        ulong target = 0;
        for (int j = 0; j < len; j++)
        {
            target = (target << 2) | codeTable[frag[j]];
        }

        ulong mask = (2 * len) < 64 ? ((1UL << (2 * len)) - 1) : ~0UL;
        ulong window = 0;
        int last = len - 1;
        for (int j = 0; j < last; j++)

            window = (window << 2) | codeTable[seq[j]];
        }

        int count = 0;
        for (int j = last; j < seqLen; j++)
        {
            window = (window << 2) | codeTable[seq[j]];
            if ((window & mask) == target)
            {
                int pos = j - last;
                bool match = true;
                for (int t = 0; t < len; t++)
                {
                    if (seq[pos + t] != frag[t])
                    {
                        match = false;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (match)
                {
                    count++;
                }
            }
        }
        return count;
    }

    private static byte[] ReadAllStdin()

        {
            MemoryStream buffer = new MemoryStream();
            byte[] chunk = new byte[1 << 16];
            int read;
            while ((read = stdin.Read(chunk, 0, chunk.Length)) > 0)
            {
                buffer.Write(chunk, 0, read);
            }
            return buffer.ToArray();
        }
    }

            start = (i < data.Length) ? i + 1 : data.Length;
            end = IndexOfByte(data, 62, start); // next '>' header, if any
            if (end < 0)

                end = data.Length;
            }
        }
        else
        {
            start = 0;
            end = data.Length;
        }

        // Compact the sequence in place: uppercase letters, drop whitespace.
        int write = 0;
        for (int read = start; read < end; )

            if (b <= 32)

            }
            if (b >= 97 && b <= 122)
            {
                b = (byte)(b - 32);
            }
            data[write++] = b;
            read++;
        }
        return write;
    }

    private static int FindThreeHeader(byte[] data)
    {
        int pos = 0;
        while (true)
        {
            int gt = IndexOfByte(data, 62, pos);
            if (gt < 0)
            {

            if (gt + 6 <= data.Length

                && data[gt + 2] == 72   // 'H'
                && data[gt + 3] == 82   // 'R'
                && data[gt + 4] == 69   // 'E'
                && data[gt + 5] == 69)  // 'E'
            {
                return gt;
            }
            pos = gt + 1;
        }
    }

    private static int IndexOfByte(byte[] data, byte value, int start)
    {
        for (int i = start; i < data.Length; i++)
        {
            if (data[i] == value)

            }
        }
```

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Globalization;
using System.IO;
using System.Text;

public static class Program
{
    private static readonly string[] FragmentNames =
    {
        "GGT",
        "GGTA",
        "GGTATT",
        "GGTATTTTAATT",
        "GGTATTTTAATTTATAGT"
    };

    private static readonly byte[][] FragmentBytes = BuildFragmentBytes();

    private static readonly byte[] CodeTable = BuildCodeTable();

    private static byte[] BuildCodeTable()
    {
        byte[] table = new byte[256];
        for (int c = 0; c < 256; c++)
        {
            table[c] = (byte)(c & 3);
        }
        table['A'] = 0;
        table['C'] = 1;
        table['G'] = 2;
        table['T'] = 3;
        return table;
    }

    private static byte[][] BuildFragmentBytes()
    {
        byte[][] result = new byte[FragmentNames.Length][];
        for (int i = 0; i < FragmentNames.Length; i++)
        {
            string name = FragmentNames[i];
            byte[] bytes = new byte[name.Length];
            for (int j = 0; j < name.Length; j++)
            {
                bytes[j] = (byte)name[j];
            }
            result[i] = bytes;
        }
        return result;
    }

    public static void Main(string[] args)
    {
        // Harness contract: N is passed as args[0]. This benchmark is driven entirely
        // by stdin, so N is parsed (per contract) but does not affect the result.
        if (args != null && args.Length > 0)
        {
            int n;
            int.TryParse(args[0], out n);
        }

        byte[] data = ReadAllStdin();
        int seqLen = ExtractThreeSequence(data);

        // ---- 1-mer and 2-mer counts (single pass over the sequence) ----
        int[] counts1 = new int[256];
        int[] counts2 = new int[65536];
        int[] codeTable = CodeTable;
        int prev = -1;
        for (int j = 0; j < seqLen; j++)
        {
            int c = data[j];
            counts1[c]++;
            if (prev >= 0)
            {
                counts2[(prev << 8) | c]++;
            }
            prev = c;
        }

        StringBuilder output = new StringBuilder(1024);
        AppendFrequencies(output, counts1, 256, seqLen, 1);
        output.Append('\n');
        AppendFrequencies(output, counts2, 65536, seqLen - 1, 2);
        output.Append('\n');

        for (int f = 0; f < FragmentNames.Length; f++)
        {
            int count = CountFragment(data, seqLen, FragmentBytes[f]);
            output.Append(count);
            output.Append('\t');
            output.Append(FragmentNames[f]);
            output.Append('\n');
        }

        Console.Out.Write(output.ToString());
    }

    private static void AppendFrequencies(StringBuilder sb, int[] counts, int space, int total, int k)
    {
        if (total <= 0)
        {
            return;
        }

        List<int> indices = new List<int>();
        for (int i = 0; i < space; i++)
        {
            if (counts[i] > 0)
            {
                indices.Add(i);
            }
        }

        // Descending count, ties broken by ascending k-mer name (index order == name order).
        indices.Sort(delegate(int a, int b)
        {
            int byCount = counts[b].CompareTo(counts[a]);
            if (byCount != 0)
            {
                return byCount;
            }
            return a.CompareTo(b);
        });

        double denominator = total;
        for (int e = 0; e < indices.Count; e++)
        {
            int i = indices[e];
            double pct = 100.0 * counts[i] / denominator;
            sb.Append(pct.ToString("F3", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
            sb.Append(' ');
            if (k == 1)
            {
                sb.Append((char)i);
            }
            else
            {
                sb.Append((char)(i >> 8));
                sb.Append((char)(i & 255));
            }
            sb.Append('\n');
        }
    }

    private static int CountFragment(byte[] seq, int seqLen, byte[] frag)
    {
        int len = frag.Length;
        if (len == 0 || seqLen < len)
        {
            return 0;
        }

        byte[] codeTable = CodeTable;
        ulong target = 0;
        for (int j = 0; j < len; j++)
        {
            target = (target << 2) | codeTable[frag[j]];
        }

        ulong mask = (2 * len) < 64 ? ((1UL << (2 * len)) - 1) : ~0UL;
        ulong window = 0;
        int last = len - 1;
        for (int j = 0; j < last; j++)
        {
            window = (window << 2) | codeTable[seq[j]];
        }

        int count = 0;
        for (int j = last; j < seqLen; j++)
        {
            window = (window << 2) | codeTable[seq[j]];
            if ((window & mask) == target)
            {
                int pos = j - last;
                bool match = true;
                for (int t = 0; t < len; t++)
                {
                    if (seq[pos + t] != frag[t])
                    {
                        match = false;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (match)
                {
                    count++;
                }
            }
        }
        return count;
    }

    private static byte[] ReadAllStdin()
    {
        using (Stream stdin = Console.OpenStandardInput())
        {
            MemoryStream buffer = new MemoryStream();
            byte[] chunk = new byte[1 << 16];
            int read;
            while ((read = stdin.Read(chunk, 0, chunk.Length)) > 0)
            {
                buffer.Write(chunk, 0, read);
            }
            return buffer.ToArray();
        }
    }

    private static int ExtractThreeSequence(byte[] data)
    {
        int header = FindThreeHeader(data);
        int start;
        int end;
        if (header >= 0)
        {
            int i = header;
            while (i < data.Length && data[i] != (byte)'\n')
            {
                i++;
            }
            start = (i < data.Length) ? i + 1 : data.Length;
            end = IndexOfByte(data, (byte)'>', start);
            if (end < 0)
            {
                end = data.Length;
            }
        }
        else
        {
            // No ">THREE" header: treat the whole input as raw sequence data.
            start = 0;
            end = data.Length;
        }

        // Compact in place: uppercase a-z, drop whitespace, skip any header lines.
        int write = 0;
        for (int read = start; read < end; )
        {
            byte b = data[read];
            if (b <= 32)
            {
                read++;
                continue;
            }
            if (b == (byte)'>')
            {
                while (read < end && data[read] != (byte)'\n')
                {
                    read++;
                }
                continue;
            }
            if (b >= (byte)'a' && b <= (byte)'z')
            {
                b = (byte)(b - 32);
            }
            data[write++] = b;
            read++;
        }
        return write;
    }

    private static int FindThreeHeader(byte[] data)
    {
        int pos = 0;
        while (true)
        {
            int gt = IndexOfByte(data, (byte)'>', pos);
            if (gt < 0)
            {
                return -1;
            }
            if (gt + 6 <= data.Length
                && data[gt + 1] == (byte)'T'
                && data[gt + 2] == (byte)'H'
                && data[gt + 3] == (byte)'R'
                && data[gt + 4] == (byte)'E'
                && data[gt + 5] == (byte)'E')
            {
                return gt;
            }
            pos = gt + 1;
        }
    }

    private static int IndexOfByte(byte[] data, byte value, int start)
    {
        for (int i = start; i < data.Length; i++)
        {
            if (data[i] == value)
            {
                return i;
            }
        }
        return -1;
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Globalization;
using System.IO;
using System.Text;

public static class Program
{
    // The specific fragments whose occurrence counts must be reported, in output order.
    private static readonly string[] FragmentNames =
    {
        "GGT",
        "GGTA",
        "GGTATT",
        "GGTATTTTAATT",
        "GGTATTTTAATTTATAGT"
    };

    private static readonly byte[][] FragmentBytes = BuildFragmentBytes();

    // Maps each byte to a 2-bit code (A=0, C=1, G=2, T=3) used for rolling hashes.
    private static readonly byte[] CodeTable = BuildCodeTable();

    private static byte[] BuildCodeTable()
    {
        byte[] table = new byte[256];
        for (int c = 0; c < 256; c++)
        {
            table[c] = (byte)(c & 3);
        }
        table['A'] = 0;
        table['C'] = 1;
        table['G'] = 2;
        table['T'] = 3;
        return table;
    }

    private static byte[][] BuildFragmentBytes()
    {
        byte[][] result = new byte[FragmentNames.Length][];
        for (int i = 0; i < FragmentNames.Length; i++)
        {
            string name = FragmentNames[i];
            byte[] bytes = new byte[name.Length];
            for (int j = 0; j < name.Length; j++)
            {
                bytes[j] = (byte)name[j];
            }
            result[i] = bytes;
        }
        return result;
    }

    public static void Main(string[] args)
    {
        // Harness contract: N is passed as args[0]. This benchmark is driven entirely by
        // stdin, so N is parsed (per contract) but does not influence the result.
        if (args != null && args.Length > 0)
        {
            int parsedN;
            int.TryParse(args[0], out parsedN);
        }

        byte[] data = ReadAllStdin();
        int seqLen = ExtractThreeSequence(data);

        // ---- 1-mer and 2-mer counts (single pass over the sequence) ----
        int[] counts1 = new int[256];
        int[] counts2 = new int[65536];
        int prev = -1;
        for (int j = 0; j < seqLen; j++)
        {
            int c = data[j];
            counts1[c]++;
            if (prev >= 0)
            {
                counts2[(prev << 8) | c]++;
            }
            prev = c;
        }

        StringBuilder output = new StringBuilder(1024);
        AppendFrequencies(output, counts1, 256, seqLen, 1);
        output.Append('\n');
        AppendFrequencies(output, counts2, 65536, seqLen - 1, 2);
        output.Append('\n');

        for (int f = 0; f < FragmentNames.Length; f++)
        {
            int count = CountFragment(data, seqLen, FragmentBytes[f]);
            output.Append(count);
            output.Append('\t');
            output.Append(FragmentNames[f]);
            output.Append('\n');
        }

        Console.Out.Write(output.ToString());
    }

    // Appends "<percentage> <k-mer>" lines, sorted by descending count then ascending name.
    private static void AppendFrequencies(StringBuilder sb, int[] counts, int space, int total, int k)
    {
        if (total <= 0)
        {
            return;
        }

        List<int> indices = new List<int>();
        for (int i = 0; i < space; i++)
        {
            if (counts[i] > 0)
            {
                indices.Add(i);
            }
        }

        indices.Sort(delegate(int a, int b)
        {
            int byCount = counts[b].CompareTo(counts[a]);
            if (byCount != 0)
            {
                return byCount;
            }
            return a.CompareTo(b); // index order == lexicographic name order
        });

        double denominator = total;
        for (int e = 0; e < indices.Count; e++)
        {
            int i = indices[e];
            double pct = 100.0 * counts[i] / denominator;
            sb.Append(pct.ToString("F3", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
            sb.Append(' ');
            if (k == 1)
            {
                sb.Append((char)i);
            }
            else
            {
                sb.Append((char)(i >> 8));
                sb.Append((char)(i & 255));
            }
            sb.Append('\n');
        }
    }

    // Counts overlapping occurrences of frag in seq[0..seqLen) using a rolling 2-bit
    // packed hash as a filter, with exact byte verification on every hash hit.
    private static int CountFragment(byte[] seq, int seqLen, byte[] frag)
    {
        int len = frag.Length;
        if (len == 0 || seqLen < len)
        {
            return 0;
        }

        byte[] codeTable = CodeTable;
        ulong target = 0;
        for (int j = 0; j < len; j++)
        {
            target = (target << 2) | codeTable[frag[j]];
        }

        ulong mask = (2 * len) < 64 ? ((1UL << (2 * len)) - 1) : ~0UL;
        ulong window = 0;
        int last = len - 1;
        for (int j = 0; j < last; j++)
        {
            window = (window << 2) | codeTable[seq[j]];
        }

        int count = 0;
        for (int j = last; j < seqLen; j++)
        {
            window = (window << 2) | codeTable[seq[j]];
            if ((window & mask) == target)
            {
                int pos = j - last;
                bool match = true;
                for (int t = 0; t < len; t++)
                {
                    if (seq[pos + t] != frag[t])
                    {
                        match = false;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (match)
                {
                    count++;
                }
            }
        }
        return count;
    }

    private static byte[] ReadAllStdin()
    {
        using (Stream stdin = Console.OpenStandardInput())
        {
            MemoryStream buffer = new MemoryStream();
            byte[] chunk = new byte[1 << 16];
            int read;
            while ((read = stdin.Read(chunk, 0, chunk.Length)) > 0)
            {
                buffer.Write(chunk, 0, read);
            }
            return buffer.ToArray();
        }
    }

    // Locates the ">THREE" FASTA record, uppercases its sequence, strips whitespace and
    // compacts it in place to data[0..seqLen). Falls back to the whole input when the
    // header is absent (raw sequence piped directly).
    private static int ExtractThreeSequence(byte[] data)
    {
        int header = FindThreeHeader(data);
        int start;
        int end;
        if (header >= 0)
        {
            int i = header;
            while (i < data.Length && data[i] != (byte)'\n')
            {
                i++;
            }
            start = (i < data.Length) ? i + 1 : data.Length;
            end = IndexOfByte(data, (byte)'>', start); // next record, if any
            if (end < 0)
            {
                end = data.Length;
            }
        }
        else
        {
            start = 0;
            end = data.Length;
        }

        int write = 0;
        for (int read = start; read < end; )
        {
            byte b = data[read];
            if (b <= 32)
            {
                read++;
                continue;
            }
            if (b == (byte)'>')
            {
                while (read < end && data[read] != (byte)'\n')
                {
                    read++;
                }
                continue;
            }
            if (b >= (byte)'a' && b <= (byte)'z')
            {
                b = (byte)(b - 32);
            }
            data[write++] = b;
            read++;
        }
        return write;
    }

    private static int FindThreeHeader(byte[] data)
    {
        int pos = 0;
        while (true)
        {
            int gt = IndexOfByte(data, (byte)'>', pos);
            if (gt < 0)
            {
                return -1;
            }
            if (gt + 6 <= data.Length
                && data[gt + 1] == (byte)'T'
                && data[gt + 2] == (byte)'H'
                && data[gt + 3] == (byte)'R'
                && data[gt + 4] == (byte)'E'
                && data[gt + 5] == (byte)'E')
            {
                return gt;
            }
            pos = gt + 1;
        }
    }

    private static int IndexOfByte(byte[] data, byte value, int start)
    {
        for (int i = start; i < data.Length; i++)
        {
            if (data[i] == value)
            {
                return i;
            }
        }
        return -1;
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Globalization;
using System.IO;
using System.Text;

public static class Program
{
    // Fragments whose occurrence counts are reported, in the required output order.
    private static readonly string[] FragmentNames =
    {
        "GGT",
        "GGTA",
        "GGTATT",
        "GGTATTTTAATT",
        "GGTATTTTAATTTATAGT"
    };

    private static readonly byte[][] FragmentBytes = BuildFragmentBytes();

    // Byte -> 2-bit code (A=0, C=1, G=2, T=3); other bytes get a deterministic code.
    private static readonly byte[] CodeTable = BuildCodeTable();

    private static byte[] BuildCodeTable()
    {
        byte[] table = new byte[256];
        for (int c = 0; c < 256; c++)
        {
            table[c] = (byte)(c & 3);
        }
        table['A'] = 0;
        table['C'] = 1;
        table['G'] = 2;
        table['T'] = 3;
        return table;
    }

    private static byte[][] BuildFragmentBytes()
    {
        byte[][] result = new byte[FragmentNames.Length][];
        for (int i = 0; i < FragmentNames.Length; i++)
        {
            string name = FragmentNames[i];
            byte[] bytes = new byte[name.Length];
            for (int j = 0; j < name.Length; j++)
            {
                bytes[j] = (byte)name[j];
            }
            result[i] = bytes;
        }
        return result;
    }

    public static void Main(string[] args)
    {
        // Harness contract: N arrives as args[0]. This benchmark is driven entirely by
        // stdin, so N is parsed (per contract) but does not influence the result.
        if (args != null && args.Length > 0)
        {
            int parsedN;
            int.TryParse(args[0], out parsedN);
        }

        byte[] data = ReadAllStdin();
        int seqLen = ExtractThreeSequence(data);

        // ---- 1-mer and 2-mer counts: one linear pass ----
        int[] counts1 = new int[256];
        int[] counts2 = new int[65536];
        int prev = -1;
        for (int j = 0; j < seqLen; j++)
        {
            int c = data[j];
            counts1[c]++;
            if (prev >= 0)
            {
                counts2[(prev << 8) | c]++;
            }
            prev = c;
        }

        StringBuilder output = new StringBuilder(1024);
        AppendFrequencies(output, counts1, 256, seqLen, 1);
        output.Append('\n');
        AppendFrequencies(output, counts2, 65536, seqLen - 1, 2);
        output.Append('\n');

        for (int f = 0; f < FragmentNames.Length; f++)
        {
            int count = CountFragment(data, seqLen, FragmentBytes[f]);
            output.Append(count);
            output.Append('\t');
            output.Append(FragmentNames[f]);
            output.Append('\n');
        }

        Console.Out.Write(output.ToString());
    }

    private static void AppendFrequencies(StringBuilder sb, int[] counts, int space, int total, int k)
    {
        if (total <= 0)
        {
            return;
        }

        List<int> indices = new List<int>();
        for (int i = 0; i < space; i++)
        {
            if (counts[i] > 0)
            {
                indices.Add(i);
            }
        }

        // Descending count; ties broken by ascending k-mer name (index order == name order).
        indices.Sort(delegate(int a, int b)
        {
            int byCount = counts[b].CompareTo(counts[a]);
            if (byCount != 0)
            {
                return byCount;
            }
            return a.CompareTo(b);
        });

        double denominator = total;
        for (int e = 0; e < indices.Count; e++)
        {
            int i = indices[e];
            double pct = 100.0 * counts[i] / denominator;
            sb.Append(pct.ToString("F3", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
            sb.Append(' ');
            if (k == 1)
            {
                sb.Append((char)i);
            }
            else
            {
                sb.Append((char)(i >> 8));
                sb.Append((char)(i & 255));
            }
            sb.Append('\n');
        }
    }

    private static int CountFragment(byte[] seq, int seqLen, byte[] frag)
    {
        int len = frag.Length;
        if (len == 0 || seqLen < len)
        {
            return 0;
        }

        byte[] codeTable = CodeTable;
        ulong target = 0;
        for (int j = 0; j < len; j++)
        {
            target = (target << 2) | codeTable[frag[j]];
        }

        ulong mask = (2 * len) < 64 ? ((1UL << (2 * len)) - 1) : ~0UL;
        ulong window = 0;
        int last = len - 1;
        for (int j = 0; j < last; j++)
        {
            window = (window << 2) | codeTable[seq[j]];
        }

        int count = 0;
        for (int j = last; j < seqLen; j++)
        {
            window = (window << 2) | codeTable[seq[j]];
            if ((window & mask) == target)
            {
                int pos = j - last;
                bool match = true;
                for (int t = 0; t < len; t++)
                {
                    if (seq[pos + t] != frag[t])
                    {
                        match = false;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (match)
                {
                    count++;
                }
            }
        }
        return count;
    }

    private static byte[] ReadAllStdin()
    {
        using (Stream stdin = Console.OpenStandardInput())
        {
            MemoryStream buffer = new MemoryStream();
            byte[] chunk = new byte[1 << 16];
            int read;
            while ((read = stdin.Read(chunk, 0, chunk.Length)) > 0)
            {
                buffer.Write(chunk, 0, read);
            }
            return buffer.ToArray();
        }
    }

    private static int ExtractThreeSequence(byte[] data)
    {
        int header = FindThreeHeader(data);
        int start;
        int end;
        if (header >= 0)
        {
            int i = header;
            while (i < data.Length && data[i] != (byte)'\n' && data[i] != (byte)'\r')
            {
                i++;
            }
            if (i < data.Length)
            {
                if (data[i] == (byte)'\r' && i + 1 < data.Length && data[i + 1] == (byte)'\n')
                {
                    i++;
                }
                start = i + 1;
            }
            else
            {
                start = data.Length;
            }
            end = IndexOfByte(data, (byte)'>', start);
            if (end < 0)
            {
                end = data.Length;
            }
        }
        else
        {
            // No ">THREE" record found: treat the entire input as raw sequence data.
            start = 0;
            end = data.Length;
        }

        // Compact in place: uppercase a-z, drop whitespace/control bytes, skip header lines.
        int write = 0;
        for (int read = start; read < end; )
        {
            byte b = data[read];
            if (b <= 32)
            {
                read++;
                continue;
            }
            if (b == (byte)'>')
            {
                while (read < end && data[read] != (byte)'\n' && data[read] != (byte)'\r')
                {
                    read++;
                }
                continue;
            }
            if (b >= (byte)'a' && b <= (byte)'z')
            {
                b = (byte)(b - 32);
            }
            data[write++] = b;
            read++;
        }
        return write;
    }

    private static int FindThreeHeader(byte[] data)
    {
        int pos = 0;
        while (true)
        {
            int gt = IndexOfByte(data, (byte)'>', pos);
            if (gt < 0)
            {
                return -1;
            }
            if (gt + 6 <= data.Length
                && data[gt + 1] == (byte)'T'
                && data[gt + 2] == (byte)'H'
                && data[gt + 3] == (byte)'R'
                && data[gt + 4] == (byte)'E'
                && data[gt + 5] == (byte)'E')
            {
                return gt;
            }
            pos = gt + 1;
        }
    }

    private static int IndexOfByte(byte[] data, byte value, int start)
    {
        for (int i = start; i < data.Length; i++)
        {
            if (data[i] == value)
            {
                return i;
            }
        }
        return -1;
    }
}
```

```csharp
    private static void AppendFrequencies(StringBuilder sb, int[] counts, int space, int total, int k)

                    {

                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (match)
                {
                    count++;
                }
            }
        }
        return count;
    }

            }

            while (i < data.Length && data[i] != (byte)'\n' && data[i] != (byte)'\r')

            if (i < data.Length)

                {
                    i++;
                }
                start = i + 1;
            }
            else
            {
                start = data.Length;
            }
            end = IndexOfByte(data, (byte)'>', start);
            if (end < 0)
            {
                end = data.Length;
            }
        }
        else
        {
            start = 0;
            end = data.Length;
        }

        int write = 0;
        int read = start;
        while (read < end)
        {

            if (b <= 32)
            {

            }
            if (b == (byte)'>')

            {

            }
            data[write++] = b;
            read++;
        }
        return write;
    }

    private static int FindThreeHeader(byte[] data)
    {
        int pos = 0;
        while (true)
        {
            int gt = IndexOfByte(data, (byte)'>', pos);
            if (gt < 0)
            {

            }
            if (gt + 6 <= data.Length

                && data[gt + 2] == (byte)'H'
                && data[gt + 3] == (byte)'R'
                && data[gt + 4] == (byte)'E'
                && data[gt + 5] == (byte)'E')
            {
                return gt;
            }
            pos = gt + 1;
        }
    }

    private static int IndexOfByte(byte[] data, byte value, int start)
    {
        for (int i = start; i < data.Length; i++)
        {
            if (data[i] == value)

                return i;
            }
        }
```
